name: Lvgl → On Landscape
description: These [triggers](https://esphome.io/components/lvgl/widgets/#triggers) fire when the display orientation changes, as determined by the effective width/height ratio of the display: `on_landscape` fires when the display becomes wider than it is tall (a square display is treated as landscape), and `on_portrait` fires when it becomes taller than it is wide. The matching trigger also fires once at boot to establish the initial orientation. A subsequent change typically results from the [`lvgl.display.set_rotation`](https://esphome.io/components/lvgl/#lvgl-display-set_rotation-action) action.
